name: Apothecary Zamah
summary: Apothecary Helbrim needs his volatile fungal emulsion carried from the Barrens to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff. The mixture must reach her laboratory beneath Spirit Rise before it loses its potency.

sections.title: A Fragile Cargo
sections.body: Apothecary Helbrim has cooked fungal blooms from the Barrens oases into a delicate emulsion. The brew quickly loses strength once prepared. Helbrim cannot travel to Mulgore in time, so he entrusts the flask to a reliable runner bound for Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: Under the Gazes of the Shamans
sections.body: Apothecary Zamah works in the Pools of Vision, a cavern beneath the sacred heights of Spirit Rise. Forsaken mages and priests share the underground refuge. Beneath the tauren sanctuary, the Royal Apothecary Society quietly studies raw materials gathered across the continent.

faq.q: Why is there a time limit on this delivery?
faq.answer: Helbrim's rendered fungal emulsion is chemically volatile. Left exposed or untreated too long, its compounds break down and lose potency, leaving the mixture useless for Zamah's work.

faq.q: Where can I find Apothecary Zamah?
faq.answer: Apothecary Zamah can be found in the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff. The cavern entrance lies concealed on Spirit Rise, beneath the shamans' tents.

Apothecary Helbrim is an alchemist of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He studies local plants and animals to learn how Kalimdor's native life might serve the Forsaken.

faq.q: What is the Royal Apothecary Society doing in Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society quietly studies specimens gathered across Kalimdor in Thunder Bluff's Pools of Vision. The Forsaken, allies within the Horde, keep representatives such as Zamah there and maintain supply links with other outposts.

faq.q: What were the fungal spores originally used for?
faq.answer: The fungal spores grow around the Barrens' lush oases, thriving in the desert. Helbrim rendered them down to study their biological traits and alchemical uses before sending them to Zamah.

faq.q: What happens if the timer runs out?
faq.answer: If the timer expires, the emulsion spoils and loses its potency. You must return to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads for a fresh batch to carry to Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: As an Undead, carrying Helbrim's work to Zamah strengthens the Royal Apothecary Society's hidden research network across central Kalimdor's frontier.
As a Tauren, you may welcome the Forsaken as allies while still eyeing their strange brews in the sacred Pools of Vision with suspicion.
As a member of the Horde, you help keep communication and supplies moving between the Barrens outposts and Thunder Bluff's high mesa.
